usedFor: WebAsk collects answers, and “New Survey Response Submitted” starts a template when a response comes in.

bestTemplate.name: “New Survey Response Submitted” in WebAsk, then “Create Customer” in Veeqo
bestTemplate.why: Each response can add the respondent as a customer elsewhere, so replies lead to a record.

watchOut: Anything a response starts that reaches the respondent waits in Needs you for your approval.
